subtasks: Insert and tighten each screw into the nut of the same color.
Fasten the loose red nut onto the fixed red bolt with the left gripper. Seat it upright and turn clockwise repeatedly to tighten it.
Fasten the loose white nut onto the fixed white bolt to the left of the red bolt. Seat it upright and turn it clockwise repeatedly to tighten it.

Use the left gripper to pick up the loose white nut just to the right of the red bolt. Fasten it onto the fixed white bolt to the left of red, turning clockwise while upright. Return the empty right arm home.
Fully open both grippers, lift the left fingers clear of the white nut and return both arms to their initial poses.
